items.lede: The company says an unnamed third-party provider was compromised. Trading has resumed, and Polymarket says affected traders will be made whole.
items.title: Polymarket Halted International Trading After Hackers Drained Accounts

items.lede: Prediction market platform Polymarket temporarily suspended trading on Thursday after hackers compromised a third-party service to distribute cryptocurrency-draining JavaScript, with approximately $2.5 million in assets traced to a suspected attacker wallet. [...]
items.title: Polymarket halts trading after crypto-draining script breach, $2.5M traced
